description_for_human: API-first CRM built for LLMs. Manage contacts, companies, deals and activities.
description_for_model: Relm is a CRM whose primary interface is an API and a native MCP server. Use it to create and update contacts (con_), companies (cmp_), deals (deal_) and activities (act_), and to manage pipelines and automations. Read /v1/schema first; on an unknown_value error use the returned valid_options. Prefer the MCP server at https://api.relmcrm.com/mcp; REST is at https://api.relmcrm.com/v1.
